title: feat(record-page): the side preview opens 460 wide, puts the record's name first with one labelled action, and lists a child tab one row per record
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbVF7sWPNE4HmjkgyaVxQYif)_
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRaJbQ4vqdv4J5peqA

Fixes #36149
Fixes #36201

Clause-②: yes (widening) — new optional members only: `RecordHeaderBar.preview` and `PageHeaderActionsProps.preview` on `@object-ui/components`, `ObjectGridComponentProps.cardFace` on `@object-ui/plugin-grid`; nothing removed or renamed (`recordPreviewWidthKey` is app-shell internal, not on its package entry)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户在列表里点开一条记录的右侧预览：预览从约 720 宽收到 460，可拖动；头部先显示完整记录名，只留一个主要按钮，「编辑」「复制编号」等都进了「更多」；子表页签每条记录一行（标题加一行摘要）。整页记录页不变。
- 属于「记录详情页重做」专题：右侧预览收紧，并解决动作按钮多时记录名被挤成几个字的问题。
- 出错时用户会在预览里找不到某个按钮，或子表显示成卡片行而不是表格；所有动作都还在「更多」里，可直接撤回本改动。
- 页签多时用「更多 N」下拉收起，和整页、手机一致（#35595 已对所有界面裁定）；不改成横向滑动。

## What changes

Both cards, one PR (1,119 changed lines incl. tests and docs, under the 1,500-line split threshold).

**Width (#36149 item 1).** The record preview opens at `RECORD_PREVIEW_DEFAULT_WIDTH` (`min(92vw, 460px)`) and its left edge drags from 380 to 900 px (`navigation-overlay`'s `DRAWER_MIN_PX` / `DRAWER_MAX_PX`). The dragged width is remembered in the browser under ONE key, `RECORD_PREVIEW_WIDTH_KEY`, for both the list's preview (`ObjectViewRecordOverlay`) and a record page's drawer level (`RecordPageDrawerHost`). Shared width, as the coordinator recommended: I found no measured reason for per-object widths. A drawer whose `navigation` authors its width (`navigation.size` other than `auto`, or a `navigation.width`, pixel or percent) does not use the shared key: `recordPreviewWidthKey` gives it the object's old per-object key (`recordOverlayWidthStorageKey`, unchanged). The list's preview reads the view's `navigation`, then the object's; a record page's drawer reads only its root record's object's `navigation`. That key is shared with the object's calendar, gantt, kanban, tree and grid overlays and a resizable `RecordDetailDrawer`, so the drawer opens at the authored width until a width is dragged in it or in one of those overlays; a width dragged in another object's preview never replaces it. Only for an object that authors no size or width does the console's preview no longer share a width with that object's calendar, gantt, kanban, tree or grid overlay or its `RecordDetailDrawer`. The width and its key belong to the drawer's root: child levels keep the root's width, and in the list a record a lookup chip opens as the root takes the list's width and key (the list object's, not the opened record's). Both hosts read the root pane's width through one helper, `recordPaneWidth` (an authored width as written, else the `navigation.size` bucket through `overlayWidthFor`, else 460), so a record page's drawer now honours its root object's authored `size`. And `useDrawerResize` drops the previous width when its `storageKey` becomes absent or holds no usable value: a record page's drawer that closed on a task at the shared 600 px opens a contract next at its authored 720 px, not at 600. `consoleSidebarRail`'s `RECORD_DRAWER_WIDTH` follows to 460, so the rail's list-width budget is unchanged in kind.

**Every resizable drawer's range (`@object-ui/components`).** The range lives in `NavigationOverlay`, so it applies to every drawer opened with a `storageKey`: the calendar, gantt, kanban, tree and grid overlays, a resizable `RecordDetailDrawer`, and the console's preview. One drawer family, one range, kept shared on purpose and declared in the changeset. Before, the drag ran from 360 px to 60% of the window; now it runs from 380 to 900 px. On a 1920 px window the widest drag drops from 1152 to 900 px. On a 1024 px window a dragged or remembered width can now reach 900 px, where 60% of the window (614 px) capped it before. It still never overflows: the card's classes cap it at the window less 1rem, so no viewport clamp was added. A remembered width under 380 px is not clamped up; it is no longer used, and the drawer opens at its host's width.

**Docs.** The plugin-view guide's 「The Console's record drawer」 section gives 460 and 380–900 px, the authored-width exception (the list reads the view's `navigation`, then the object's; a record page's drawer its root object's) and that the width belongs to the drawer's root. It says the header has no Edit button or copy icon (both in `⋯`), and that a child tab lists one row per record. The platform checklist's ~720 px drawer reads ~460 px.

**Header (#36149 items 2–4, #36201).** The preview's host bar now says `preview: true` (`RecordHeaderBar.preview`), and `page:header` draws into it this way:
- The record's name comes first. At most ONE labelled action is drawn: the page's primary (`previewPick`: the first authored `variant: 'primary'`, else the first authored action). The host's buttons (Edit) and every other action go into the `⋯` in their usual bands and order.
- That one action also folds into the `⋯` while the name would be cut below 16 characters' width (`PREVIEW_NAME_MIN_EM`, measured by `previewNameSqueezed` in the width fold's layout effect). It is not drawn back when the pane widens, except on a fresh measurement (another record, a resize), which is how the existing width fold already works.
- No copy-id icon after the name. `RecordDetailView` adds `sys_copy_record_id` (「复制记录 ID」, existing i18n keys) to the `⋯`, preview only. The name's full text is its `title` tooltip.
- Unchanged: the host's edit state (Cancel / Save stay in the row), an approval state's own levers (`RecordHeaderStateContext.group`, approve / reject), the stage tag, and a page's own header (Edit button and copy icon stay there).

**Child tabs (#36149 item 6).** In a preview, a child list's tab (the enlarged related list) hands the list grid the new host prop `cardFace` (`ObjectGridComponentProps.cardFace`). The grid then draws the phone's card rows at any window width: the title, one summary line and the status chip, one row per record. Before, it drew a table cut off at the pane's edge. 「添加」 stays top-right in the tab's toolbar. A related list outside a preview, and every non-tab related list, is unchanged.

**Already true on `main`, verified live, not rebuilt.** Item 7: clicking a child record replaces the preview's content (one drawer, no stacked preview). The leading area shows the back control and 「客户 Initech › 活动」, and back returns to the parent with the 活动 tab still selected. Item 8: header row 1 is unchanged. #36147 (click a value to edit, PR #36234) is untouched.

## Tests

- `page-header-record-bar-35593`: new describe for the preview bar. One labelled action and the rest in `⋯` in order (also with `maxVisible: 3`); no actions means only `⋯`; edit state keeps Cancel / Save; no copy icon and the name has a tooltip; the name squeezed (120 of 300 px) folds the primary. CONTROLS: a name with room keeps the action; a page bar keeps its copy icon and never folds for the name; approval levers 通过 / 拒绝 are drawn in the preview.
- `RecordDetailView.drawerLevelEdit-33111`: the list's preview and a record page's drawer level have no Edit button or copy icon. Their `⋯` has Edit and Copy record ID, and copy writes the id. CONTROL: the record page's own header keeps the Edit button and copy icon, with no copy menu entry. Existing drawer Edit tests go through the `⋯`.
- `cardFaceHost-36149` (plugin-grid): `cardFace` at 1440 px draws card rows (title + 「Renewal · Monday」 summary, no column headers). CONTROLS: 1440 px without it keeps the table; 390 px keeps cards.
- `RelatedList.previewCardFace-36149` (plugin-detail): a preview bar hands the grid `cardFace`. CONTROLS: none for a page bar, none for no bar, none for a non-tab list in a preview.
- Width: `navigation-overlay-drawer-27545`, `navigation-overlay-9299` (380–900 clamp), `consoleSidebarRail.width-27593` (460 and the list keeps its minimum).
- `recordPreviewWidth-36149` (app-shell): a width dragged in object A's list preview is the width object B's list preview opens at, and the width a record page's drawer opens object B at. CONTROLS: an object authoring `navigation.width` opens at 720 px with 600 px in the shared key, and a drag in its own pane writes its per-object key, not the shared one. A list preview whose view authors `size: 'xl'` ignores the shared width. `recordPreviewWidthKey` returns the shared key for none, `{}` or `size: 'auto'`, and the per-object key for `size: 'xl'` or a `width`. One mounted record-page drawer: a task at the shared 600, closed, then a contract opens at its authored 720; the reverse, a contract at its own dragged 500, closed, then a task opens at 460. A record page's drawer level opens an object authoring `size: 'xl'` at `recordPaneWidth`'s xl width. `recordPaneWidth` unit cases (none / `auto` → 460, `'50%'` as written, a `width` beats a `size`, xl differs from 460).
- `ObjectView.recordOpenPath-35854` (app-shell, the list host's wiring): with 600 in the shared key, a view authoring `size: 'xl'` opens its preview at its xl width, not 600 px. CONTROL: a view authoring no width opens at 600 px.

- Ablation (one-off, not kept), the S2 reset: the two `setWidth(null)` resets it added on the paths a close and a reopen take (the no-key branch and the key-holds-nothing branch) removed together, the pre-fix shape (blob 671df74f → 5378b1f6, then the second anchor x1 → x0). Result: `recordPreviewWidth-36149` failed 2 of 9, the forward and reverse one-mounted-drawer cases. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. Removing either line alone keeps them green: a close sends the key through absent and the next open through a key holding nothing, so each line covers the other in that sequence. A record opened while the drawer is open is a child level on the same root, so the root key never switches straight from one stored key to another.

Result: `recordPreviewWidth-36149` failed 2 of 5, the A-to-B list preview case and the list-to-record-page case. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Item 5, tabs: the ruled behaviour, shipped as-is.** The preview's tabs are the same set as the full page (详情, one per child list with its count, 动态) and never wrap. When they overflow, they fold into 「更多 N」, the dropdown that #35595 ruled for every face of the tab row, the side preview included. So the card's "horizontal swipe" wording is answered by that standing ruling, not deviated from. The seat confirmed this reading; no swipe is built.
- **Item 7, wording of the back entry.** The card shows 「‹ 父记录名」. `main` draws `←` plus 「客户 Initech › 活动」 (the trail ruled under #26679). It does the job (one preview, back to the parent, tab kept), so I left it unchanged.
- **#36201 「not restored when wider」.** The fold is decided per measurement. Widening the pane re-measures (the width fold's `ResizeObserver` clears the cap), so a wider pane can draw the primary again if the name then fits. Never more than one labelled action in a preview.
- **#36201 screenshots: app-todo stands in for HotCRM.** The card asks for the HotCRM lead 「Mira Costa - Atlas Construction」. HotCRM cannot run in this container: its checkout has no installed dependencies, and installing into that shared checkout is outside this card. The app-todo task (5 `record_header` actions) proves the same three points. The full name is readable (「Schedule dentist appointment」 is cut to 「Schedule den...」 before and whole after). At most one labelled action is drawn (Clone Task, for a short name). The rest are in `⋯`.
- **#36201's 「a record with no custom actions has the same header as today」 is superseded by #36149.** Edit and the copy icon left the preview header, so such a record's preview header is the name, the stage and `⋯`. This follows from folding the two cards into one PR, not from an omission. The full page's header is unchanged.
- Comment icon: #36406 removed it from the preview; it has merged and this branch carries it.
- Out of scope: the spec `navigation.size` describe still says `auto` derives the width from the field count and the viewport, which has not been true since #27545. Filed as #36468.
